title: Palliative Radiotherapy for Symptomatic Locally Advanced Gastric Cancer: A Phase II Trial
brief_summary: The hypothesis of this study is that a radiotherapy dose of 36Gy in 12 fractions, which equates to a BED of 48.6Gy, increases the response rates of symptom relief compared to historical controls.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Biopsy proven adenocarcinoma of the stomach
* Treated with palliative intent
* At least one index symptom such as bleeding, obstruction or pain
* No prior abdominal radiotherapy
* Not on chemotherapy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients treated with radical intent
* Previous abdominal radiotherapy
* Patients on chemotherapy
